problem.counterhypothesis: hostNetwork=false may appear sufficient because the workload does not join the node network namespace, but Kubernetes pod networking still permits policy-dependent cluster/Internet reachability unless a CNI-enforced NetworkPolicy or equivalent boundary exists.
problem.discriminator: Require an explicit ClayVerse-selecting ingress+egress default-deny NetworkPolicy, keep the baseline Service internal, and fence the source contract with deterministic static regressions before any real CNI/Kata runtime acceptance.
